## Tickerboard price feed
Called by the Tickerboard dashboard through the n8n connector. Query: mode=quotes|chart|search, symbols=comma list (max 40), range=1d|5d|1mo|6mo|ytd|1y|5y|max, or from/to (unix seconds, daily closes), q=search text. Data from Yahoo Finance public chart API (unofficial, no key). Exchange delays apply.
